newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says nuclear power plant on stream in 3 years.
newsitem.headline: Iran says nuclear power plant on stream in 3 years.

text.p: A nuclear power station in the southern Iranian port of Bushehr will come on stream in three years, an official was on Tuesday quoted as saying.

"The Atomic power plant of Bushehr is scheduled to be ready for operation by the next three years in cooperation with Russia," Reza Amrollahi, head of Iran's Atomic Energy Organisation, said in remarks carried by the Tehran Times newspaper.
He said the plant, Iran's first nuclear power station, was being built "in coordination" with the International Atomic Energy Agency.
Russia has signed an $800 million deal with Iran to complete the plant despite U.S. objections that Tehran might use the technology to develop nuclear arms.
Iran has repeatedly denied it has any intention of building a nuclear bomb. It says it wants alternative sources of energy and that its nuclear sites are open to international inspection.
A subsidiary of Germany's Siemens AG started building the plant in the Gulf port of Bushehr in the 1970s, but work was suspended after the 1979 Islamic revolution.
